candidates.claim: OUTSIDE_IN, bound inbound on the outside interface, has an effective first-match permit of tcp/22 from any source to 10.10.10.21 (an OT SCADA host), so outside and vendor traffic can open a connection into the OT side.
candidates.remediation: Remove the fw-01:59 permit so that tcp/22 from OUTSIDE to 10.10.10.21 is denied, and reconcile the added entry against the approved baseline.

candidates.claim: The effective permit at fw-01:59 allows tcp/22 from OUTSIDE to the OT host 10.10.10.21, which is not one of the approved cross-zone services A1-A7.
candidates.remediation: Remove the fw-01:59 permit so that only approved OT cross-zone services are reachable from OUTSIDE.
